assumptions.stop_surface: MEASURED DEVIATION: production is the ExecStart of the systemd USER unit gx10-occamy-nvfp4.service (Restart=on-failure, --rm); the system-scope unit of that name is inactive, which is what the card checked. docker stop deletes the container (AutoRemove=true, measured) and the unit recreates it within ~1 s, so the variant is given the port by `systemctl --user stop|start gx10-occamy-nvfp4.service`, not by docker stop/start.
assumptions.token_capacity: max_total_num_tokens is re-profiled from free memory at every start: 1,306,681 on the 4-day-old process -> 1,644,272/1,624,512/1,663,872/1,620,892 after successive restarts with no flag changed. The restore gate therefore requires the four config keys to match exactly and reports capacity with its delta, rather than calling a proven restore failed.
assumptions.budget: S1 and S2 each spent 900 (888 battery + 12 probe) = the whole 1800; S3 was launched once for the arg-parser verdict and needed no requests.
assumptions.prompt_identity: rows are paired with S0 by (depth, arm, turn) because salts and chain construction are identical: prompt_tokens matched 888/888 for both S1 and S2.
assumptions.fan_out: not measured: the battery has no fan-out arm (S0's B/A fan-out comes from a different cell).
